prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     If object is found, grab it, check properties and perform specific task. Otherwise, move or scan area.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = IsObjectFound    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Action ID = MoveToLocation    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectFound? THEN
			SEQUENCE
				DO GrabObject
				DO CheckObjectProperties
				DO SpecificTask
			END
	END
